LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_Biosynthesis.label: synthetic biology
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_Biosynthesis.description: Cultured strains built from the ground up, engineered to reassemble simple nutrients and mineral feedstock into complex organic macromolecules. They synthesize neutroamine, edible artiprotein and comparable organic polymers at far higher efficiency than any conventional process, and require neither fields nor livestock to do it.\n\nApproved by █████ and ███, synthetic biology and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Provision of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and derived biosynthesis lines are to be operated only within orbital installations and fleet supply nodes.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_Biosynthesis.discoveredLet:
Researchers have opened a class I sealed file containing the gene maps and metabolic pathways of a set of engineered culture strains.

Artiprotein can now be refined from crops in a reaction chamber, and neutroamine synthesized from meat and chemfuel. The artifuscle chamber can also grow artificial muscle from artiprotein and tungsteel, with no gold or neutroamine required.

The fleets did not seal this file over weapons. A colony that synthesizes its own protein and drug precursors stops buying them from anyone. Running these lines will be noted.
